title: SDD Spec — cli
content:
## CLI Specification
Automation surface for listing, validating, mutating, comparing, and injecting project environments with secrets redacted by default.

### Acceptance Scenarios
1. GIVEN a project with envy.yaml mapping development to .env WHEN the user runs `envy list` for development THEN keys are listed and schema-marked secrets are shown redacted
2. GIVEN envy.yaml defines required REDIS_URL and it is absent from development WHEN the user runs `envy check --env development` THEN the command exits non-zero and reports REDIS_URL as missing
3. GIVEN schema type integer for PORT and PORT=abc in the env file WHEN the user runs `envy check` THEN PORT is reported invalid with reason expected integer
4. GIVEN development and production env files WHEN the user runs `envy diff staging production` THEN presence/absence and non-secret value differences are shown with warnings for missing keys and divergent values
5. GIVEN REDIS_URL is schema-marked secret WHEN the user runs `envy get REDIS_URL` without an explicit reveal flag THEN the value is redacted and the plaintext secret is not printed
6. GIVEN an interactive human session WHEN the user runs `envy set REDIS_URL redis://localhost:6379 --env development` THEN the value is written to the development provider and subsequent `envy list` shows the key configured
7. GIVEN REDIS_URL exists in development WHEN the user runs `envy delete REDIS_URL --env development` THEN the key is removed from that environment and no longer appears in list/check as present
8. GIVEN a valid development environment WHEN the user runs `envy run development -- npm run dev` THEN the child process inherits resolved env vars and non-secret defaults from schema
9. GIVEN a .env file on disk WHEN the user runs `envy import .env --env development` THEN keys are merged into development without printing secret values to stdout
10. GIVEN production is configured WHEN the user runs `envy export production` THEN export output redacts secrets by default unless an explicit reveal flag is provided
11. GIVEN .env is not in .gitignore and a secret appears in .env.example WHEN the user runs `envy doctor` THEN those checks fail, a health score is printed, and secrets are never written to the report
12. GIVEN CI mode and a missing required variable WHEN the user runs `envy check --env production --ci` THEN the process exits non-zero suitable for failing a pipeline
13. GIVEN no agent grant exists WHEN an operator runs `envy agent grant claude-code --env development --write --ttl 30m` THEN write is allowed for that agent/env until expiry and read_values remains denied by default
14. GIVEN an active grant for claude-code WHEN the operator runs `envy agent revoke claude-code` THEN subsequent agent writes for that identity are denied
15. GIVEN any successful or denied mutation WHEN a CLI command completes THEN an audit entry records actor, operation, key, environment, timestamp, and result without storing plaintext secrets
